Donor and recipient filing history

Source: R/features.R
add_filing_history.Rd

Adds the donor's final-return flag and whether it filed again later, and the recipient's formation year, whether it is newly formed, and whether it filed after the merger year.

Usage

add_filing_history(fl, header, new_entity_years = 1L)

Arguments

fl

Filing table from sn_filings().

header

990 header rows (F9-P00-T00-HEADER) for donors and recipients, with EIN2, TAX_YEAR, OBJECTID, F9_00_RETURN_FINAL_X, F9_00_RETURN_INITIAL_X, and F9_00_YEAR_FORMATION.

new_entity_years

A recipient formed (or filing an initial return) within this many years before the merger year counts as new.

Value

fl with FINAL_RETURN, DONOR_FILES_LATER, R_FORMED, R_INITIAL_NEAR, R_NEW, R_IN_EFILE, and R_FILES_LATER.
